audience_problem: A fictional adult folds two paper doors, then writes what she actually came to do on a tiny shopping list.

hook.text: Which door matches why you came here?

packaging.title: Two Signup Paths. One Real Question.
packaging.promise: A purpose note turns an abstract account choice into a concrete reading task.

sources.claim: The U.S. registration guide has consumer and distributor paths and lists SSN/bank information in the distributor path.

retention_beats.purpose: Narration turn: Atomy’s U.S. guide separates consumer and distributor registration. The distributor path includes Social Security and bank information.
Narration turn: She puts the list between the doors. First name your purpose. Then read the matching path.
Narration turn: The official guide is in the caption.

experiment.assignment_note: Three videos per variant across three topic families. Observational matched batch, not a randomized causal test.

review_scope: Packaging-to-script alignment reviewed. No claim of audience performance or automatic fact checking.
